name: @ship/fixture-ok-third-party-runtime-deps
description: PF-717 POSITIVE control, and the reason the rule is not 'one dependency only'. An integration is a stranger and strangers install npm packages — PF-716 says so in as many words ('Third-party runtime deps are fine (@slack/bolt, express)'). A checker that rejected this would be over-broad, and every future integration would route around it. MUST be accepted.
